Question: What is the best life advice you would give?
Answer: A woman gets stuck in her child's love!!! For nine months and ten days, when one soul resides within another, forming a bond between two lives, that is where she gets stuck. Unable to walk, unable to speak, but the subtle emotions she feels from her baby inside her body. She gets stuck in those unexpressed tears. When the baby cries out loud, people wonder why she sheds tears like that for her child! Little do they know her mind is on an endless journey to know why her child is crying. Thousands of uncertainties get stuck in this way. Exhausted, her body breaks down repeatedly in broken sleep. She seems to be constantly restless in her child’s thoughts. When a fever arises in the deep of the night, she gets stuck in the turmoil of trying to bring down the temperature. Stuck in sleepless nights. Even after going to eat the food, when she feels, "Wait, has my baby eaten?". Sometimes, her food remains uneaten. Stuck in the magical aura of hearing the mother's call for the first time! It may sound a little strange to hear, but every woman experiences such a feeling at some point in her life!! Even if insulted a hundred thousand times, even being abused, she stays only for her child. The decision to go away repeatedly halts "mother". When the magical eyes of the mother turn towards the child. Where will I go, without my child... I won't be able to leave, it's not possible, she thinks!! A woman gets stuck in the love, affection, and magic of her child. I have a small advice in life for all those children when they grow up. Never forget your mother. My advice is very small, but it shall be of great blessing to me if all of you heed to it. Signing off, LOKI

Question: How do I use thyristors?
Answer: Thyristors are versatile semiconductor devices that are quite simple yet surprisingly powerful. Let me try to break down what they can do and how you can unleash theiir abilities in various practical applications. From dimming the lights in our homes to regulating large motors, thyristors are the unsung heroes behind the scenes in vast areas of electric circuit control. Their magic lies in one unique property — once turned on, they stay on until the thyristor is manually shut off. This on-off-on ability through Gate trigger signals makes them ideal for switching large loads such as those found in appliance regulators and elevators. Here is a drawing of the diagram and basic construction of a thyristor. One needs to simply supply a voltage pulse at the Gate terminal of the thyristor to flip its internal switch from blocking to conducting vast currents. The on/off switching speed can be finely tuned through gate trigger timing. By carefully varying the pulse width, we can effectively control the amount of voltage passing through. One could make light lamp dimmer by connecting a thyristor to an AC line, then flick its gate on and off at different pulse rates to give lower light intensities. Connected to sensors, they can convert real world variables like temperature, pressure or flow directly into electrical switching states to run appliances. LOKI Image credit: Pinterest
